# Remember Me

> Remember Me is a free web app for remembering the people you love: their birthdays and special days, the little things they like, their wishlists, and your own birthday too. It works in any browser and can be installed on a phone. Noor, a little birthday candle, is the friendly guide inside the app.

## What it does

- **Your people and their days:** add the people you care about with their birthdays (with or without the year), anniversaries, graduations, work milestones, remembrance days and other days, plus the "little things" they love. Someone who has passed away can be marked "In memory", so their days are remembered gently, without countdowns or gift ideas.
- **Reminders:** by email and, if you turn it on, by push notification: 14, 7 or 3 days before, the day before and the morning of, at 9:00 in your time zone.
- **Wishlists:** "My birthday" (shared with your connections) and "Treat yourself" (private), each wish with a link, price, note and photo.
- **Secret reservations:** connected friends can reserve a gift from your birthday wishlist. Others see it's taken; you never learn who reserved it.
- **Connections:** invite someone with a private link (it works for one person, for 7 days) to see each other's birthdays and birthday wishlists.
- **Birthday plans:** a short checklist for each person's day (gift, message, call, cake), ticked as you go.
- **Celebrate Me:** a countdown to your own birthday, a plan for your day, reminders about it if you want them, and a note to future you that stays sealed until your next birthday.
- **Your data:** download everything as a file, or delete your account and everything in it at once. No ads, no tracking cookies.

Sign up with Google or email. It's free.
